subject: Next steps: security intake & SIG initiation — Fintegral
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fintegral.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: security intake & SIG initiation — Fintegral

Hi Maria — great to meet earlier today. Thanks for the demo time and for outlining the use case for Fintegral's customer-facing analytics. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

1) Security posture check (what we heard)
   - You mentioned Fintegral is targeting SOC 2 Type II and currently in the process of compilation.
   - GDPR is applicable for EU customers; HIPAA scope is limited to a subset of PHI workflows.

2) Asks from Fintegral we captured
   - Confirm SOC 2 status and expected report date
   - Clarify whether a VPC/private deployment is required for the initial pilot
   - Data residency / encryption-at-rest KMS requirements

3) Immediate next step: initiate the SIG/CAIQ vendor intake so your security team can scope the evidence requests.

I'm attaching a short "Redwood SIG Request" (PDF stub) and our SIG prefill template to speed things up. Can you: 
- Confirm the best email for your security intake (is security@fintegral.com the right mailbox?), and
- Share an estimated timeline for when you'd like the SIG completed (2 weeks / 4 weeks / 8 weeks)?

Proposed dates for a short follow-up: I can do a 20-min sync on Thursday 9/3 between 9–11am PT or Friday 9/4 in the afternoon — whichever works for your security lead.

Thanks — I'll kick off the intake as soon as you confirm the contact.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments:
- redwood_sig_request_form.pdf (stub)
- sig_prefill_template.xlsx (stub)

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fintegral.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: security@fintegral.com
Date: 2026-09-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: security intake & SIG initiation — Fintegral

Thanks Ava — good recap. A few clarifications from our side before you open the SIG: 

- SOC 2: We are currently completing SOC 2 Type II; fieldwork finishes 2026-10-10 and we expect the final report by mid-November. Will that timing be acceptable for the pilot?
- Deployment: Early pilot needs to be in our VPC (we require private networking and customer-managed keys for prod). For the initial sandbox/proof-of-concept we can consider hosted if encryption at rest is customer-managed.
- Evidence asks: for encryption-at-rest we will need concrete details on KMS provider (do you support AWS KMS / customer-managed CMKs?), key rotation policy, and whether Redwood's hosted option segregates tenant keys.

We prefer to use security@fintegral.com for the intake mailbox. Please route technical evidence requests to myself and cc security@fintegral.com.

Could you also confirm if you can prefill the SIG with answers on your infrastructure (network segregation, IAM, encryption, logging) so our team has fewer clarifying Qs?

Best,
Maria Gomez
Head of Information Security | Fintegral Systems
maria.gomez@fintegral.com

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@fintegral.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, security@fintegral.com
Date: 2026-09-01T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: security intake & SIG initiation — Fintegral

Thanks Maria — super helpful. Quick answers and proposed plan: 

- SOC 2 timing: mid-November is fine for the production rollout; for the pilot we can proceed on a limited scope while you finalize the report. We'll note the SOC 2 Type II final report date in the SIG and mark any controls that are still in progress.

- Deployment & KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for Dedicated and Private deployments (AWS KMS CMKs are supported). For the hosted option we offer tenant-segregated keys with optional Bring-Your-Own-Key for certain enterprise customers; I'll include the exact KMS options in the SIG prefill.

- Prefill: Yes — we'll prefill the standard SIG/CAIQ sections covering network segmentation, IAM, encryption, logging/monitoring, and SOC 2 status. That should reduce back-and-forth.

Proposed immediate steps: 
1) I will formally initiate the SIG intake and attach our prefilled answers (see attached SIG prefill).
2) We will flag controls where your SOC 2 is still pending and provide expected evidence delivery dates.
3) Ben (cc'd) will follow up with a short list of the exact artifacts we typically provide (config screenshots, key management docs, SOC 2 report when available).

Could you confirm the target turnaround for the SIG once we open it? Typical customer timelines range from 10–21 calendar days, depending on evidence availability.

I'll plan to open the intake against security@fintegral.com later today once I have your confirmation. Also booking a 20-min intake call for Thurs 9/3 9:30am PT — I'll send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks,
Ava
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com

Attachments:
- sig_prefill_template.xlsx (stub)

Subject: Re: Next steps: security intake & SIG initiation — Fintegral

Looping in operational items from my side — thanks for the heads up. 

Ben here from the security operations side at Redwood. Quick note on artifacts we'll provide once the SIG is opened: 
- KMS doc: high-level architecture + supported providers (AWS KMS with CMKs, GCP KMS support noted), key rotation cadence, and customer-managed key patterns.
- Network segregation: VPC peering and private endpoint diagrams for Dedicated/Private options.
- Logging & monitoring: sample retention windows, Splunk/Datadog integration notes, and access controls.
- SOC 2: we will attach our SOC 2 Type II report as soon as it's available; meanwhile we'll include the status and relevant evidence for controls that are already in place.

If Maria/security@fintegral.com can share a single point of contact for evidence collection (name + time zone + best times), we'll tailor the initial evidence bundle to match your preferred format (PDF, screenshots, or shared Drive link).
